title: Natural Vegetation and Wildlife
subtitle: Understanding India's Rich Flora and Fauna
subject: Social Science (Geography)
author: Shine Academy EduOS AI
learning_outcomes: Identify different types of natural vegetation in India.
Understand the factors affecting flora and fauna.
Recognize the importance of wildlife conservation.
Locate major national parks and sanctuaries in India.

ai_context.learning_goal: Student should master the classification of forests and understand the distribution of wildlife in India.
common_misconceptions: All forests in India have the same types of trees.
Wildlife is evenly distributed across all states.
ai_context.tutor_hint: If the student struggles with forest types, ask them how rainfall affects plant growth.
